title: AgreementMetadata
description: Metadata for REA agreements between parties. Agreements are protocol-level primitives; this schema describes the metadata shape that shefa uses to track obligation state and fulfillment.

obligor.description: Agent ID of the party who must fulfill

action.description: REA action: produce | consume | transfer | use

resourceConformsTo.description: What resource specification this obligation targets

fulfilled.description: Whether this obligation has been fulfilled

fulfillmentCriteria.description: Human-readable description of what constitutes fulfillment

coverageLimit.description: REA Measure representing maximum coverage amount for insurance agreements
